moral.zh: 脸上的光照到镜子的光滑反射层，按规律反射进入眼睛，大脑便看见了镜后的像。
moral.en: Light from a face reflects regularly from a smooth mirror layer into the eyes, creating a clear image.

pages.enText: After washing her hands, Xiaoyu stood before the bathroom mirror. “Why can a mirror show me?”
